title: Levi Strauss & Co. migration case study (lab 2) quiz

questions.stem: Contoso Apparel is shifting from selling through wholesalers to selling directly to consumers, and its leaders approve a move to Azure. Which reason best explains why this business change drives the cloud migration?
questions.zhStem: Contoso Apparel 正从通过批发商销售转向直接面向消费者销售，管理层批准迁移到 Azure。哪个理由最能说明这一业务变化为何推动云迁移？
options: Keeping a separate ERP system in each country gives local teams more control
A direct-to-consumer model needs speed, automation, and unified data on a standard platform
Running its own datacenters is cheaper than paying for Azure resources
Moving to the cloud removes the need for any business process changes
questions.explain: A direct-to-consumer model needs speed, automation, and unified data, because selling directly to customers depends on fast change and consistent data that the old fragmented systems could not provide.
questions.zhExplain: 直接面向消费者的模式需要速度、自动化和统一的数据，因为直接向客户销售依赖快速变化和一致的数据，而原有分散的系统无法提供这些。

questions.stem: A migration team at Contoso is starting discovery for about 160 applications spread across several datacenters. Which question should they ask now to plan the migration waves?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的迁移团队正开始对分布在多个数据中心的约 160 个应用进行发现。他们现在应该提出哪个问题来规划迁移批次？
options: Which new features should developers add once everything runs on Azure?
What will the right-sized Azure bill be one year after cutover?
Which Azure VM size should every server use after migration?
Which applications depend on each other and must move in the same wave?
questions.explain: Ask which applications depend on each other, because dependent applications must move in the same wave or they break during migration.
questions.zhExplain: 应询问哪些应用相互依赖，因为相互依赖的应用必须在同一批次迁移，否则迁移期间会出现故障。

questions.stem: In Contoso's RACI matrix, the infrastructure director is Accountable for migrating servers in waves, while the migration team carries out the replication and cutover. Which letter should the migration team have for this activity?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的 RACI 矩阵中，基础设施总监对分批迁移服务器负最终责任（Accountable），而迁移团队负责实际执行复制和切换。迁移团队在这项活动中应标注哪个字母？
options: R, because they do the actual work of the migration
A, because they also give final approval for the activity
C, because they only give advice before the work starts
I, because they only receive updates about progress
questions.explain: The migration team is R (Responsible), because the people who do the work are Responsible while only one person is Accountable for the result.
questions.zhExplain: 迁移团队应标为 R（Responsible，执行者），因为实际做事的人是执行者，而对结果负最终责任的只有一个人。

questions.stem: Contoso runs nine regional ERP systems with different processes in each country, and it wants one set of standard processes and unified data. Which migration approach fits these ERP systems?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 运行着九个区域性 ERP 系统，每个国家的流程各不相同，而公司希望拥有统一的标准流程和数据。哪种迁移方式适合这些 ERP 系统？
options: Rehost each ERP system as-is onto Azure virtual machines
Retire all nine ERP systems without any replacement
Replace them with one global ERP platform
Refactor each ERP system onto Azure Kubernetes Service
questions.explain: Replace the nine systems with one global ERP platform, because rehosting or refactoring each one would keep nine different processes and data models.
questions.zhExplain: 应用一个全球 ERP 平台替换这九个系统，因为对每个系统做重新托管或重构仍会保留九套不同的流程和数据模型。

questions.stem: Contoso pays heavily every month to run its own datacenters and has about 160 applications to move. Which approach should it use first for most servers, and why?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 每月都要为运营自有数据中心支付高昂费用，并有约 160 个应用需要迁移。对大多数服务器应首先采用哪种方式？为什么？
options: Refactor every application first, so nothing needs changing after the move
Replace every application with SaaS, so no servers need migrating at all
Retire the datacenters first, then decide what to do with the applications
Rehost first, to exit the costly datacenters fastest and improve workloads later
questions.explain: Rehost first, because lift and shift exits the costly datacenters fastest, while rearchitecting 160 applications beforehand would delay both the exit and the savings.
questions.zhExplain: 应先重新托管，因为直接迁移能最快退出昂贵的数据中心，而先重构 160 个应用会推迟退出和节省成本的时间。

questions.stem: Contoso has finished discovery and built its Azure landing zone, and it is about to migrate business-critical workloads. What should the schedule include before the main migration waves?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已完成发现并搭建好 Azure 着陆区，即将迁移业务关键型工作负载。在主要迁移批次之前，计划中应包含什么？
options: Decommission the old datacenters so that teams cannot fall back
A pilot that moves low-risk servers to test replication, cutover, and rollback
Right-size all Azure resources and tune costs for the coming year
Move all 160 applications together during a single weekend
questions.explain: Run a pilot with low-risk servers first, because it tests replication, cutover, and rollback before business-critical workloads are at risk.
questions.zhExplain: 应先用低风险服务器做试点，因为这样可以在业务关键型工作负载承担风险之前测试复制、切换和回滚。

questions.stem: Contoso's architects are listing criteria to decide how each workload will move to Azure. Which item is a technical criterion rather than a business criterion?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的架构师正在列出用于决定每个工作负载如何迁移到 Azure 的标准。以下哪一项是技术标准而不是业务标准？
options: Whether the workload can be rehosted as-is on Azure
How much Azure costs compared with owning datacenters
How soon the company can close its datacenters
How much downtime stores and online sales can accept
questions.explain: Whether a workload can be rehosted as-is is a technical criterion, because it is about compatibility, while cost, speed, and acceptable downtime are business criteria.
questions.zhExplain: 工作负载能否原样重新托管属于技术标准，因为它关乎兼容性，而成本、速度和可接受的停机时间属于业务标准。
